The component calls `useFeatureFlag(flagName)`, a React hook in `esm-react-utils`. It reads the flag from a shared zustand store (`featureFlagsStore`) through `useStore`, which subscribes with `useSyncExternalStore`, so the component re-renders when the flag changes. The store is seeded from `localStorage` and written back on every change. The Implementer Tools "Feature Flags" tab is the usual way the value gets switched.

**Implementation, in order of the read path**

- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useFeatureFlag.ts:18-23`: the hook. It returns `flags[flagName]?.enabled ?? false`, so an unregistered flag reads as off.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useStore.ts:69-96`: the generic store hook. Lines 76-85 hold the `subscribe`/`getSnapshot` pair that drives `useSyncExternalStore`.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts:14-27`: creates `featureFlagsStore` from `localStorage` and writes changes back to `openmrs:feature-flag:*` keys.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts:29-42`: loads persisted flags from `localStorage` on startup.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts:54-65`: `registerFeatureFlag`, which declares a flag and keeps its current enabled state.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts:91-93`: `getFeatureFlag`, the non-React accessor. It has no guard, so it throws if the flag was never registered.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts:105-109`: `subscribeToFeatureFlag`, the non-React subscription.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-feature-flags/src/feature-flags.ts:112-119`: `setFeatureFlag`, marked `@internal` for the Implementer Tools toggle.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/index.ts:28` and `.../src/public.ts:22`: re-export `useFeatureFlag` from the package.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/mock.tsx:83` and `.../mock-jest.tsx:78`: test mocks that return `true` by default.

**Documentation**

- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/feature-flags.mdx:7-10`: explains the toggle is stored per browser in `localStorage`, that the app shell can enable registered flags for everyone, and that `useFeatureFlag` is the recommended React API.
- `openmrs-contrib-o3-docs/content/en-US/docs/feature-flags.mdx:14-30`: a worked example. It registers a `laser-eyes` flag in `routes.json` and then uses `useFeatureFlag`.
- `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-react-utils/src/useFeatureFlag.ts:5-17`: the JSDoc usage example. The generated reference is `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/functions/useFeatureFlag.md`, linked from `openmrs-esm-core/packages/framework/esm-framework/docs/API.md:210`.

**Caveat:** `getFeatureFlag` and `subscribeToFeatureFlag` dereference `flags[flagName]` without a guard, so they can throw for an unregistered flag. The docs say to use them only after registration. `useFeatureFlag` avoids this by returning `false`.

I did not locate the Implementer Tools component that calls `setFeatureFlag`. The docs describe it, but I did not read its source.
